name: todo-collector
description: Get every TODO, FIXME, HACK and BUG comment in your code into one list: owners from TODO(name), urgency from !!! or “urgent”, and, in a git repo, who wrote each one and when — so old forgotten items stand out. Set priorities and owners in the table, then export a CSV you can import as issues or a TODO.md checklist grouped by priority, owner or file. Runs locally; no issue tracker account or API keys.

description_i18n.en: Get every TODO, FIXME, HACK and BUG comment in your code into one list: owners from TODO(name), urgency from !!! or “urgent”, and, in a git repo, who wrote each one and when — so old forgotten items stand out. Set priorities and owners in the table, then export a CSV you can import as issues or a TODO.md checklist grouped by priority, owner or file. Runs locally; no issue tracker account or API keys.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把代码里所有的 TODO、FIXME、HACK、BUG 注释汇总成一张清单：从 TODO(名字) 读出负责人，从 !!! 或“紧急”判断优先级；在 git 仓库里还能看到每条是谁、什么时候写的，放了很久被遗忘的一眼就能看出来。在表格里设好优先级和负责人，再导出可以导入任务系统的 CSV，或者按优先级、负责人、文件分组的 TODO.md 清单。在本地运行，不需要任务系统账号或 API 密钥。
